fields.title: Reaching Lives Across The Country
fields.description: At the heart of what we do is continuous prayer for the Unreached People Groups (UPGs). We systematically commit everyday one UPG from the entire UPGs and then specifically one UPG in the African portion of the 10/40 window.

fields.title: We Pray
fields.description: Engage in powerful prayer sessions, lifting up the needs of our community, nation, and the world. Our prayer warriors are committed to seeking God's guidance and intervention in all areas of life.

fields.title: We Fellowship
fields.description: Go beyond the walls of our church building to reach and impact communities. Through outreach programs and missions, we aim to share the love of Christ and meet the practical needs of those around us.

fields.title: We Disciple
fields.description: We invest in the spiritual growth, development of individuals and provide teaching, mentorship, and support to help believers deepen their relationship with God and live out their faith in meaningful ways.

fields.title: ABOUT US
fields.banner_subtitle: Proclaiming the Gospel to unreached people groups across Northern Nigeria since 2006.
fields.introduction: Hasken Rayuwa Afrika Ministry exists to demonstrate the Father’s redemptive love among the Unreached People Groups (UPGs) of the African portion of the 10/40 window. Our mission is to actively participate in fulfilling the Great Commission, aiming to see its completion within our lifetime. Through dedicated efforts and compassionate outreach, we strive to bring the light of hope and transformation to those who have yet to experience the message of redemption.
fields.ministry_goal:
Our goal is to fully reach the African portion of the 10/40 window with the gospel of the Lord Jesus Christ. This we will do as we establish and send 100 Go Teams to the regions of this portion where darkness is prevalent to bring the light of the gospel in the face of Jesus Christ.

We train, organize and host short-term mission trips and medical missions, we also encourage volunteers who will go and support our Go Teams.
fields.cta_body: Millions remain unreached across Northern Nigeria. Every prayer, every hour of service, every gift — it all moves the needle of eternity.

fields.title: DAY 1 – 'JESUS' FILM
fields.description:
When one of our teams arrive in a village, they meet with leaders, gather the local people, and invite them to watch the 'Jesus' film and other follow up films.

The 'Jesus' Film provides a powerful presentation of the life of Christ in the indigenous languages of the people. Many who see the 'Jesus' film have never seen a film before. Traditionally, most of the people who see the 'Jesus' Film would love place their trust in Jesus Christ but for the fear of radical Islam.

fields.title: DAY 2 – FOLLOW UP
fields.description: The next morning, our teams follow up with villagers by going door to door, introducing them to an audio Bible in their native language, and inviting them to watch 'Walking with Jesus' in the evening.

fields.title: DAY 3 – SMALL GROUPS
fields.description: HRAM's teams continue door to door ministry with and invite people to small groups held in the afternoon. They facilitate these small Bible studies, called LAMP groups, using lesson plans and audio Bibles. In some places these activities are met with strong resistance instead we stick with the night film shows.

fields.title: DAY 4 – DISCIPLESHIP
fields.description:
In the morning the teams follow up with all the people who gave their lives to the Lord and appoint a village leader to lead their LAMP group. The HLA teams advise the new LAMP leader on facilitating groups, watch him lead the next lesson, and equip him to continue groups and give weekly feedback to the HRAM's team.

The last evening of the village outreach, our teams show any of the 'Walking with Jesus' film, and lessons over the Holy Spirit, walking in the Spirit, and growing in Christ.

fields.mission_text: Hasken Rayuwa Afrika Ministry exists to demonstrate the Father’s redemptive love among the Unreached People Group (UPGs) and the African portion of the 10/40 window and thereby help in bringing the Great Commission to a Great Completion in our lifetime.
fields.vision_text:
We see the white and ready fields of the African portion of the 10/40 window and empowered by the spirit of God, our organization trains and sends indigenous people that will bring in the great harvest in these last days.

And so I have made it my aim to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build on another man's foundation. Romans 15:20

fields.title: Our Challenges
fields.description:
We need your support to continue and expand our efforts. By donating or volunteering, you can help us provide education to more children in northern Nigeria.

Your contribution can make a significant difference in the lives of these children and their communities. Join us in empowering the next generation through education.
fields.challenge1_desc:
The 10/40 Window is a region that stretches horizontally across the globe from Africa to Asia

This area is home to a significant number of unreached people who have yet to hear the Gospel of Jesus Christ.

To put this into perspective, for every 10 people in this part of the world, nearly 5 are yet to hear about Jesus Christ.
fields.challenge2_desc:
Prayer is a powerful tool in reaching those who have yet to hear the Gospel.

By dedicating time to pray for these unreached populations, we can help pave the way for spiritual breakthroughs and support the efforts of missionaries working in these challenging areas.
fields.challenge3_desc:
Education is a vital tool for breaking the cycle of poverty and empowering the next generation. In Nigeria, however, millions of children are missing out on this essential opportunity.

According to UNICEF, 18.3 million children in Nigeria are out of school.

The Hasken Arewa Foundation (HAF) is dedicated to helping these children by providing educational support and resources.

To date, we have successfully helped 30 children return to the classroom, but the need is far greater.

To provide educational support for 1,000 children each year, we require at least $7,000 annually.

This funding goes towards school supplies, tuition fees, and other essential resources that enable these children to receive a proper education.

fields.name: Ibrahim Nathaniel
fields.bio:
In the August of 2014, the Lord impressed on Ibrahim’s heart to relocate to Sokoto. Ibrahim grew up mostly in the rural setting in Nigeria and had the opportunity to experience missions at a tender age having been raised by parents who were good Christians and missions minded.

After graduating from the university in 2007, Ibrahim knew that the call of God upon his life must be followed and not thrown away.

In following that call, Ibrahim faced a lot of persecution and pressure to abandon it, but he still held on trusting God alone to lead the way.

Ibrahim served as the president of Nigeria Christian Corpers Fellowship (NCCF), Lagos where the major focus is Rural Rugged Evangelism, after his National Youth Serve Corp (NYSC) he also served as an associate Pastor at Paraclete Chapel, Zuru Kebbi State for 3 years.

It was at the expiration of the 3 years in Zuru that Ibrahim moved to Sokoto to follow the burden in his heart for the world harvest.

Today as the National Director at Hasken Rayuwa Afrika Ministry, a ministry he helped founded from the start with the help and mentorship of Here’s Life Africa Mission based in Arusha, Tanzania in East Africa, he ministers in the remote villages of Northern Nigeria and Niger Republic where men, women and children are daily won into the Kingdom.

Ibrahim and his wife Gotname are based in Sokoto with their two children Jasmine Charisa and Joshua Salim.

fields.title: HASKE PROJECTS
fields.introduction: At Hasken Rayuwa Afrika, one of our main activities is humanitarian outreach. We assist underprivileged communities, especially in northern Nigeria, with both their physical needs and the Gospel. Many villages face environmental challenges and insurgency-related hardships. Our outreach aims to support as many individuals and communities as possible in these areas.

fields.title: Well Construction
fields.description: Water pollution, poorly constructed wells, and villages without a source of water cause a lot of disease to the partakers of such water and this seems to be the reality of many villages/communities in the northern part of Nigeria. As the saying goes “Prevention is better cure’’.  Northern Nigeria being a desert state has its disadvantages and difficulties in reaching a reasonable water level due to harsh dry weather. HRAM brings hope and life by digging wells.

fields.title: Feeding the Community/Villages
fields.description: Malnutrition is one of the severe health issues affecting many villages due to poverty and scarcity of resources. Giving out food and gifts to households, Cash gifts for farmers go a long way in adding value, giving a sense of purpose and love in the lives of the most vulnerable of the communities.

fields.title: Medical Outreaches
fields.description: Poor Health Care centers in most villages; diseases like Noma disease, malaria, typhoid, and infections are easily contracted because of poor hygienic environment and lack of preventive measures towards such sicknesses and diseases. We have partnered with organizations such as the Medicine Sans Frontier to bring drugs and Health education to villages and communities.

fields.title: Community Empowerment
fields.description: Grinders, water pumps, and soft loans for farmers are distributed by HRAM to reduce the impact of poverty, so that these individuals' hope will be restored and so that parents will have a means of feeding their families.

fields.title: VOLUNTEER
fields.introduction:
Hasken Rayuwa Afrika believes that For the Great Commission to be fulfilled there have to be those who will Go, Give, and Pray. We the body of Christ have our role to play.
There are over 70 million unreached Muslims in Northern Nigeria alone, and we cannot reach them without the proper number of those who will go, give, and pray.
These are the threefold that will bring about the fulfillment of the kingdom. Become a Volunteer Today.

fields.title: Go-Teams
fields.description: Team Philemon, Barnabas, Luke, Mark, Epaphras, Apollo, Titus, Timothy, and Silas. These nine teams play their roles as the individuals who go for the ministry, to the unreached, empowered, and anointed they travel in twos.

fields.title: Prayer Partners
fields.description: When Jesus taught his Disciples to pray, He said "Abba Father, Hallo be thy name, thy Kingdom come, thy will be done on earth as it is in Heaven" This means prayer is one of the requirements if the will of God must be done on the earth. Jesus speaks saying “My house shall be called the house of prayer”. Prayer cannot be overemphasized when it comes to the fulfillment of God's will on earth. This is why we are seeking those who will join us in prayer for the fulfillment of the will of God upon the surface of the earth.

fields.title: Give
fields.description: Again proclaim, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: “My cities shall again spread out through prosperity; The Lord will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.” Zechariah 1:17, It's impossible for the Gospel of Christ to be peached without resources. One of these resources is finances. The spreading of the Gospel requires resources, so therefore there has to be those that will give.

fields.title: We Gave Bible Translations
fields.content:
In a world where language and culture define the way people connect to their faith, the importance of reading sacred texts in one’s native tongue cannot be overstated. This week, we had the incredible opportunity to bring that connection closer to reality by distributing Bible translations to communities in Sokoto, Nigeria.

Empowering Communities Through Scripture
Sokoto is known for its vibrant culture and deep-rooted traditions. However, many individuals in the region have limited access to religious texts in their native languages. Recognizing this need, our team worked diligently to provide translated Bibles, making the Word of God accessible to more people.

During our visit, we met with local leaders, families, and youth. The joy and gratitude they expressed as they received their copies of the translated Bible were truly heartwarming. One of the recipients, a young woman named Amina, shared how this gift would deepen her understanding of her faith and help her connect with her community on a spiritual level.

The Impact of Native Language Scripture
When people can read and reflect on the Bible in their own language, the message resonates more deeply. It allows them to explore their faith in a way that feels personal and relatable. For many in Sokoto, this was the first time they had access to a Bible written in their mother tongue.

The translations we provided were not just books; they were bridges—connecting individuals to their spiritual heritage and fostering a sense of unity within the community. In addition, we supplied other faith-based resources to support their spiritual growth.

A Shared Mission
This initiative was made possible through the collaboration of various partners, whose support was invaluable. Together, we are committed to spreading hope, love, and understanding by ensuring that every individual has access to spiritual resources in the language they understand best.

Looking Ahead
Our work in Sokoto is just the beginning. We are inspired to continue this mission, bringing translated Bibles to other regions in need. The smiles and stories we encountered in Sokoto reaffirmed our belief in the power of language to transform lives.

We extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who made this initiative possible, and we look forward to sharing more stories of impact as we move forward.
